QuestInfo.name: So Lonely
QuestInfo.0: Anne didn't have any friends and was lonely.
QuestInfo.1: Anna was tired of playing alone. She wanted someone to play dolls, Hide-and-Seek, and jacks with her. Alpha and Beta went to find her a friend.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta introduced Aramia to Anne and hoped they would become BFFs!
